sourceSentences: Vorpal Spikes basic attack resets Cho'Gath's basic attack timer.
Enemies struck are dealt magic damage and slowed by an amount that decays over 1.5 seconds.

Cho'Gath ruptures the target location after a delay, granting sight of the area before dealing magic damage to enemies within and knocking them up for 1 second, and afterwards slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds.
The delay before the rupture does not include the cast time.
The area will still rupture even if Cho'Gath dies during the delay.
Cleansing the airborne will not prevent the slow.
The slow itself can also not be blocked by spell shield, but will always be prevented if the airborne was.
Enemy champions and hit are also silenced for a duration.
The width of the blast of spikes increases based on Cho'Gath's character size modifier when they launch, including but not limited to the bonus from Feast stacks.
Cho'Gath's size factors into the wideness of the hitbox Vorpal Spikes has. External size modifiers (Wild Growth) contribute to this.
If the target is killed, Cho'Gath gains a stack of Feast. Only 6 stacks can be gained from non-epic monsters or minions.
Non-Champion True Damage 1200 (+ 50% AP) (+ 10% bonus health)
If an enemy champion has health below the amount of true damage Feast deals, they will be marked for execution. This indicator does not consider shields or invulnerability.
Carnivore will also trigger when Cho'Gath destroys a turret, but not from other structures.
Carnivore does not trigger upon destroying wards and possibly other similar units.
The first combo is the auto attack E combo. You should always auto attack first and then press your ability after so you can deal more damage.
The second combo is auto EQ combo. This combo lets you deal your damage and hit Q more easily because of the slow.
The third combo is Q auto EW. This is a great combo that lets you auto tech and then use your E as well during the knockup of your Q.
you can have a maximum of six stacks on the wave here.
you can stack permanently on champions. So, champions do not have a limitation. It's only the wave itself that has a limitation.
For a combo: attack, press E, then instantly do two more hits
Add Q, punch, and W, then keep attacking until you can eat the target with your ultimate.
Your initiative input: Q, punch, and E. Add W, then attack again until you can eat them.
Although you only benefit from the first six minions or monsters eaten, it can accumulate charges infinitely by eating champions and epic monsters.
Increasing the size gives him a bonus to his attack radius and also makes his E wider.
